sentences.text: Researchers analyzed computational patterns of active histone marks to identify functional DNA regions called enhancers and distinguish specific ways genes are turned off in different cell types.

This approach enabled the creation of computer models that predict gene regulation based solely on DNA sequences, offering a complete system for labeling the brain's regulatory DNA and understanding genetic risks for diseases.
